trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: WHAT: The platinum itself. It unlocks on its own the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned, so there is nothing separate to hunt. HOW: Work the roadmap in order — story first while protecting the one Chapter 1 meditation, then the 100% checklist, then collectibles and cleanup — and use the tracker header to watch the per-grade counts close in on 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver and 46 bronze. WHEN: It can never be missed, because every other trophy stays available in free-roam after the story; the only save-sensitive item in the whole list is flagged on Positive Mental Attitude. Sources beside this guide name the full official list and the roadmap this plan follows.
steps: Finish the story (Stage 1) and keep a manual save at the start of every chapter.
Complete the 100% checklist for A Long Road (Stage 2).
Sweep collectibles and activities (Stages 2-3), then misc cleanup (Stage 4).
The platinum pops automatically when trophy 54 of 54 lands.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: WHAT: Finish Gone Fishing, the opening story mission. HOW: Simply play the prologue sequence the game starts with; the trophy pops when the mission complete screen appears. There are no optional objectives tied to it. WHEN: Story trophies unlock automatically as you play and none of the twelve story trophies can be missed, but there is no mission replay, so enjoy it the first time through. Keep cheats off for the whole run — guides report cheats disable trophies and saving for the session. Sources beside this guide carry the official list entry and the story-first roadmap.
steps: Start a new game and play the opening mission Gone Fishing.
Reach the mission complete screen.
Keep a manual save right after it, before Chapter 1 free-roam begins.

sources.name: Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: WHAT: Finish every main mission of Chapter 1. HOW: Follow the story markers to the chapter's closing mission; the trophy lands at the chapter end. WHEN — IMPORTANT: Chapter 1 holds the list's one reported missable collectible, the meditation spot at Jason's house that counts toward Positive Mental Attitude. Do that meditation before you finish the chapter, and keep a manual save at the chapter start as insurance, because there is no mission replay. The chapter trophy itself is automatic and cannot be missed. Sources beside this guide document the Chapter 1 missable and the no-replay warning.
steps: Make a manual save as soon as Chapter 1 begins.
Meditate at the spot at Jason's house before the chapter ends.
Play the chapter's story missions to the end card.

sources.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List: Missables and Roadmap

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: WHAT: Finish every main mission of Chapter 2. HOW: Play the chapter through; from Chapter 2 both Jason and Lucia are playable, which is also when the partner trophies elsewhere in this guide start becoming practical. WHEN: Automatic on chapter completion and not missable. Keep the habit of a fresh manual save at the chapter start — with no mission replay, rotating saves are your only safety net for save-sensitive side content. Sources beside this guide give the official list entry and the chapter-based roadmap.
steps: Save manually at the start of Chapter 2.
Complete the chapter's story missions in order.
Once both protagonists are playable, start trying partner activities in free-roam.

sources.name: Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: WHAT: Finish every main mission of Chapter 3. HOW: Play the chapter through to its end card. Guides note the robbery trophies begin opening up around Chapters 3 and 4, so bank vaults, armored trucks and gang operations you meet from here on are worth doing properly rather than rushing past. WHEN: Automatic and not missable. Keep a manual save at the chapter start, and keep scanning new vehicles and animals as you travel — those counters are far easier built up during the story than farmed later. Sources beside this guide cover the list and the robbery unlock timing.
steps: Save manually at the start of Chapter 3.
Complete the chapter's story missions.
Do robberies properly as they unlock instead of skipping them.

sources.name: Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: WHAT: Finish every main mission of Chapter 4. HOW: Play the chapter through; by now every robbery type and most activity types should have appeared at least once, which also feeds Master of None. WHEN: Automatic and not missable. One more chapter-start manual save, and before the finale make one extra save you never overwrite — guides stress there is no mission replay and no New Game Plus, so that save is your route back if a late choice bothers you. Sources beside this guide carry the official entry and roadmap context.
steps: Save manually at the start of Chapter 4.
Complete the chapter's story missions.
Before the final mission, park one permanent manual save you never overwrite.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: WHAT: Finish the final story mission — one of only two gold trophies in the list. HOW: Play the campaign to its conclusion; the trophy pops at the end of the finale. After the credits you are returned to free-roam and the 100% Completion checklist becomes viewable under Progress, which is where Stage 2 of the roadmap begins. WHEN: Automatic and not missable, but save before starting the finale: with no mission replay, a pre-finale save is the only way to revisit any endgame choice. Sources beside this guide confirm the gold grade, the story structure and the post-story checklist.
steps: Keep a manual save before starting the final mission.
Complete the finale and watch the credits.
Open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion to begin Stage 2.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: WHAT: Finish the named story mission Breakfast Run. HOW: It arrives as part of the main campaign flow; follow the story markers and complete it like any main mission — no optional medal or side condition is attached. WHEN: Automatic when the mission ends and not missable, since it sits on the critical path. If you are using the spoiler setting in this tracker, this is exactly the kind of story entry that stays hidden until earned. Sources beside this guide carry the official name and description.
steps: Follow the main story until Breakfast Run begins.
Complete the mission to its end screen.

sources.name: Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: WHAT: Finish the named story mission The Cartel Heist. HOW: A main-campaign heist mission; play it through the story path and the trophy pops on completion. Treat it as practice for the free-roam robbery trophies — vault timing and clean getaways are the same skills Maximum Withdrawal asks for later. WHEN: Automatic and not missable. Sources beside this guide carry the official entry and the list it belongs to.
steps: Reach The Cartel Heist in the main story.
Complete the heist and escape to the mission end screen.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: WHAT: Finish the named story mission Child's Play. HOW: It is part of the main campaign; follow story markers and complete it. No grade-medal or optional objective is required by the official description — completion alone earns it. WHEN: Automatic and not missable. Sources beside this guide carry the official name, description and grade.
steps: Reach Child's Play in the main story.
Complete the mission to its end screen.

sources.name: Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: WHAT: Finish the named story mission Headliners. HOW: A main-campaign mission; play it on the story path and finish it. WHEN: Automatic on completion and not missable. Like every story entry here it stays behind the spoiler setting in this tracker until you have earned it, which is the polite way to browse the list mid-playthrough. Sources beside this guide carry the official entry.
steps: Reach Headliners in the main story.
Complete the mission to its end screen.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: WHAT: Finish the named story mission VCIA Takedown, set around Vice City International Airport. HOW: Play it on the main story path to completion. The airport setting is also where the free-roam trophy Catch Me If You Can happens later, so learning the VCIA layout here pays off in Stage 4 cleanup. WHEN: Automatic and not missable. Sources beside this guide carry the official entry and list.
steps: Reach VCIA Takedown in the main story.
Complete the mission; note the airport layout for later cleanup.

sources.name: Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: WHAT: Finish the named story mission Operation Savage Glory. HOW: A main-campaign mission; follow the story markers and complete it. WHEN: Automatic on completion and not missable. Sources beside this guide carry the official name, description and grade from the published list.
steps: Reach Operation Savage Glory in the main story.
Complete the mission to its end screen.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: WHAT: Reach 100% on the in-game completion checklist — the second gold and, per the cited roadmaps, the hardest and longest trophy in the game at roughly 200 hours to platinum overall. HOW: The checklist only becomes viewable after the story, under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion, but everything you did during the story already counts. The cited guides stress the thresholds are lenient — closer to 60% of true completion: for example only 70 of 80 challenges, and partial collectible totals, are required, while robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests must be finished in full. WHEN: Nothing on the checklist is missable; work it in Stage 2 after the finale. Sources beside this guide give the checklist structure and the lenient thresholds.
steps: Finish the story to reveal Progress > Stats > 100% Completion.
Work the checklist groups: story tasks, exploration and activities, discovery.
Prioritise the must-complete lines: robberies, shooting ranges, drone races, Bret's quests.
Use the 70-of-80 challenges allowance to skip the hardest challenges.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: WHAT: Complete 250 stunts. HOW: The cited guides count 397 stunt locations in the game, so you need a little over half of them — and the 100% checklist actually asks for 300, which means finishing A Long Road overshoots this trophy on the way. Stunts are the marked jump and stunt spots scattered across Leonida; clear them region by region while exploring for The Goodtime State so travel time does double duty. WHEN: Never missable; stunts stay in free-roam forever. Best done across Stages 2-3 rather than in one grind. Sources beside this guide give the 250-of-397 figure and the checklist overlap.
steps: Pick up stunts opportunistically whenever you cross a new area.
Sweep region by region until the counter passes 250.
Keep going to 300 if you are finishing the 100% checklist anyway.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: WHAT: Try each of the game's activity types at least once — the starter list counts 9 types. HOW: As each activity type unlocks during the story and free-roam (races, fishing, arcade games, bowling, meditation, shooting range, drone races and the rest), start one round of it; you only need to try it, not win it. Most players earn this naturally by mid-story if they accept new map icons instead of ignoring them. WHEN: Not missable; every activity type remains available in free-roam. Sources beside this guide carry the official description and the activity coverage.
steps: Accept each new activity icon the first time it appears.
Start one round of every distinct activity type.
Check the tracker: 9 types tried and the trophy pops.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: WHAT: Gold-medal all 42 Shooting Range challenges. HOW: Work range by range; learn each challenge's target pattern with a couple of practice runs, then chase the gold score with controlled bursts rather than full-auto spray. The cited roadmaps rate the range golds as not too difficult, and shooting ranges are one of the must-complete lines of the 100% checklist, so this silver is on the platinum critical path anyway. WHEN: Not missable; ranges can be replayed freely in free-roam. Use the counter in this tracker (x / 42) as you clear them. Sources beside this guide confirm the 42 count and the checklist requirement.
steps: Open a shooting range and run each challenge once to learn its targets.
Replay for gold: short bursts, prioritise accuracy bonuses.
Repeat across all ranges until the counter reads 42 / 42 gold.

sources.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List: Missables and Roadmap

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: WHAT: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. HOW: The cited guides count 14 drone race locations (with 42 races across them, but the trophy only asks for a win at each location). Learn each course with one exploratory flight, then race it cleanly — smooth lines through gates beat raw speed that ends in crashes. Drone races are also a must-complete line of the 100% checklist, so this belongs in Stage 3 alongside the checklist sweep. WHEN: Not missable; races stay available in free-roam. Sources beside this guide give the 14-location count.
steps: Fly each location once to learn the gate order.
Race again for the win; keep lines smooth rather than flat-out.
Tick locations off in the tracker until it reads 14 / 14.

sources.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List: Missables and Roadmap

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: WHAT: Win 20 different races — repeats of the same race do not add to the count. HOW: Spread your wins across the race series on the map instead of replaying a favourite; bring a vehicle suited to each class and learn the first three corners, where AI fields usually tangle and gift positions. WHEN: Not missable; races remain in free-roam. Natural to finish during Stage 3 while clearing activities for the checklist. Sources beside this guide carry the official description.
steps: Enter races across different series and locations.
Win with a class-appropriate vehicle; protect the lead on the final lap.
Track distinct wins until the counter reads 20 / 20.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: WHAT: Beat Cal, the fishing character, in a head-to-head fishing challenge. HOW: Unlock fishing through the story and Cal's strand, practise the catch timing on ordinary fish first, then take his challenge and focus on clean, fast catches rather than the biggest fish. WHEN: Not missable; the challenge can be retried in free-roam. Sources beside this guide carry the official description and list context.
steps: Unlock fishing and meet Cal through his strand.
Practise the catch timing on free fishing spots.
Enter Cal's challenge and out-catch him.

sources.name: Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: WHAT: Complete one arcade game, start to finish. HOW: Find an arcade cabinet in free-roam, pick the shortest game on offer, and play it to its completion screen rather than quitting mid-run — starting a game is not enough, the official description says complete. WHEN: Not missable and one of the quickest bronzes in the list; grab it the first time you pass an arcade, which also ticks one activity type toward Master of None. Sources beside this guide carry the official description.
steps: Enter an arcade in free-roam.
Choose the shortest cabinet game available.
Play to the completion screen without quitting.

sources.name: Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: WHAT: Finish Andy's side-mission strand by completing his final mission. HOW: Work Andy's strand missions in order as they appear on the map; the trophy pops at the end of his last one. Side-character finales like this one sit alongside the main chapters in Stage 1 of the roadmap, so clear strands as they open instead of leaving a pile for cleanup. WHEN: Not flagged missable by the cited guides; strands stay available, but finishing them during the story keeps Stage 4 short. Sources beside this guide carry the official description.
steps: Start Andy's strand when its icon appears.
Complete each of his missions in order.
Finish his final mission for the trophy.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: WHAT: Finish Kenton's side-mission strand by completing his final mission. HOW: Follow Kenton's strand missions in order as they unlock; the trophy lands at the end of the last one. WHEN: Not flagged missable by the cited guides. Do strands during the story (Stage 1) so the post-game is free for the 100% checklist. Sources beside this guide carry the official description.
steps: Start Kenton's strand when it appears.
Complete his missions in order.
Finish his final mission for the trophy.

sources.name: Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: WHAT: Finish Billy's side-mission strand by completing his final mission. HOW: Play Billy's strand missions in order as they open on the map; completion of the finale earns the trophy. WHEN: Not flagged missable by the cited guides; still, strands are cheapest during the story when you are already travelling between chapters. Sources beside this guide carry the official description.
steps: Start Billy's strand when it appears.
Complete his missions in order.
Finish his final mission for the trophy.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: WHAT: Complete 8 full mission strands for strangers across Leonida. HOW: Each strand is a chain of missions for one stranger character — the Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone finales in this list are strand endings, so those five count toward the eight; find three more strands on the map and finish them end to end. The cited roadmap puts Strangers & Freaks in the final cleanup step because it is not part of the 100% checklist, which is why this tracker stages it in Stage 4. WHEN: Not missable; strands persist in free-roam. Sources beside this guide confirm the 8-strand count and the cleanup-step placement.
steps: Finish the five named character strands (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone).
Pick up three further stranger strands from map icons.
Complete each strand's final mission; counter reaches 8 / 8.

sources.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List: Missables and Roadmap

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: WHAT: Finish Randy's side-mission strand by completing his final mission. HOW: Work Randy's strand missions in order as they appear; the finale earns the trophy and also counts as one of the eight strands toward Strangers & Freaks. WHEN: Not flagged missable by the cited guides. Sources beside this guide carry the official description.
steps: Start Randy's strand when it appears.
Complete his missions in order.
Finish his final mission for the trophy.

sources.name: Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: WHAT: Finish Tyrone's side-mission strand by completing his final mission. HOW: Play Tyrone's strand missions in order as they unlock; the finale earns the trophy and counts toward the eight strands of Strangers & Freaks. WHEN: Not flagged missable by the cited guides. Sources beside this guide carry the official description.
steps: Start Tyrone's strand when it appears.
Complete his missions in order.
Finish his final mission for the trophy.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.missable_note: MISSABLE — the Chapter 1 meditation spot at Jason's house disappears after Chapter 1. Meditate there before finishing the chapter, and keep a manual save at the chapter start: there is no mission replay.
trophies.guide: WHAT: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across Leonida. HOW: Spots are marked meditation locations in the world; interact at each one and stay through the meditation. Work them region by region alongside exploration for The Goodtime State. WHEN — THIS IS THE LIST'S ONE REPORTED MISSABLE: the cited guides agree the first spot, at Jason's house during Chapter 1 (also described as Lucia's balcony meditation), disappears once Chapter 1 ends. Do it before you finish Chapter 1, and keep a manual save at the chapter start, because there is no mission replay to go back with. The other 17 spots remain available all game. Sources beside this guide are the ones that flag this missable.
steps: In Chapter 1, meditate at the spot at Jason's house BEFORE finishing the chapter.
Keep a manual save at the start of Chapter 1 as a safety net.
Sweep the remaining spots region by region until the counter reads 18 / 18.

sources.name: Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies
Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List: Missables and Roadmap

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: WHAT: Hunt the unique animal Bret asks for, as part of Bret's quest line. HOW: Take Bret's quests as they open — the cited roadmap lists Bret's quests among the must-complete lines of the 100% checklist — follow the hunt to the unique animal, and bring it down cleanly. Studying animals through binoculars for the discovery counters can be done on the same trips. WHEN: Not missable; Bret's quests remain available and are required in full for 100%. Sources beside this guide confirm Bret's quests sit on the checklist's must-complete list.
steps: Start Bret's quest line when it appears.
Follow the hunt objectives to the unique animal.
Take the animal down to complete the quest.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: WHAT: Complete 3 full Collectible Card sets. HOW: The cited guides count 18 card sets in the game, and the 100% checklist needs 15 of them — so this silver's 3 sets are only the first milestone on a much longer road. Collect cards as you explore, complete the shortest sets first to bank this trophy early, then keep going for the checklist. WHEN: Not missable; cards stay in the world. Sources beside this guide give the 18-set total and the 15-set checklist requirement.
steps: Pick up every card you pass while exploring.
Finish the three shortest sets first to earn the trophy.
Keep collecting — 15 sets are needed for the 100% checklist.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WHAT: Use WAiNK at 100 different locations. HOW: WAiNK spots are scannable world locations; build the habit of scanning whenever you enter a new block, beach or interior, and sweep district by district with exploration for The Goodtime State (52 areas) so the two counters climb together. WHEN: Not missable; locations remain scannable in free-roam. Sources beside this guide carry the official description and grade.
steps: Scan at every new location you enter from Chapter 2 onward.
Sweep district by district so no cluster is left behind.
Stop when the tracker counter reads 100 / 100.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: WHAT: Complete 50 challenges. HOW: The cited challenge guide counts 80 challenges in 8 categories of 10 (combat, criminal, exploration, fitness, shopping, sports, survival, vehicle), all available from the start and viewable under Progress > Challenges. Most complete automatically while you work other trophies; check the menu periodically and mop up the cheap ones in each category. You need 50 here and 70 for the 100% checklist, so the 10 you may skip should be the hardest, not the first you meet. WHEN: Not missable. Sources beside this guide give the 80-challenge structure.
steps: Open Progress > Challenges early to see the 8 categories.
Let story and free-roam play complete most challenges naturally.
Mop up easy unfinished ones until the counter reads 50 / 50 (aim for 70 for 100%).

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: WHAT: While your partner is with you, reach a 4-star wanted level and then lose it completely. HOW: In free-roam with Jason and Lucia together, build heat deliberately to four stars, then break line of sight and hide until the stars drain — tunnels, alleys and switching vehicles all help, and the escape only counts once the wanted level is fully gone with your partner still present. WHEN: Not missable; repeatable in free-roam any time both protagonists are together, which the cited list notes is from Chapter 2 onward. Sources beside this guide carry the official description and the partner availability note.
steps: Free-roam with your partner after both are playable (Chapter 2).
Commit crimes until the wanted level reaches 4 stars.
Break line of sight and stay hidden until all stars clear.

sources.name: Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: WHAT: Rob 3 shops in a row with your partner while keeping a wanted level the whole time. HOW: Pick a cluster of three shops close together, rob the first, and move directly to the next without hiding long enough for the stars to clear — the chain breaks if your wanted level fully drops between shops. Keep a fast car outside each door and your partner with you throughout. WHEN: Not missable; repeatable in free-roam with both protagonists. If a chain breaks, simply start again at the first shop. Sources beside this guide carry the official description.
steps: Choose three shops within a short drive of each other.
Rob shop one and drive straight to shop two, keeping the wanted level alive.
Rob shop three before the stars ever fully clear.

sources.name: Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: WHAT: Discover 100 different vehicles. HOW: The cited roadmap says the 100% checklist wants 200 of the game's 277 base model vehicles scanned, so this trophy's 100 is the halfway point of a counter you should be building from the start: get in, or scan, every new model you see parked or in traffic, and vary your hunting ground — beaches, marinas, airports and rich districts spawn different fleets. WHEN: Not missable; do it passively during the story and finish in Stage 2. Sources beside this guide give the 200-of-277 checklist figure.
steps: Enter or scan every new vehicle model you spot.
Rotate districts to find different vehicle pools.
Reach 100 discovered (keep going to 200 for the 100% checklist).

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: WHAT: Drop 5 enemies during one single activation of Combat Focus, the slow-motion combat ability. HOW: Set the fight up before you trigger it: pick a robbery gone loud or a gang operation where five or more enemies cluster in one room or yard, top up your health and ammo, then activate Combat Focus and work target to target without wasting shots on cover. If a run ends at four, reload the situation and retry — it is a setup trophy, not a skill wall. WHEN: Not missable; repeatable in any busy firefight. Sources beside this guide carry the official description.
steps: Find a fight with at least 5 enemies in one area (robbery or gang operation).
Position with a loaded weapon and full health.
Trigger Combat Focus once and take down 5 enemies before it ends.

sources.name: Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: WHAT: Make an 'unscheduled departure' at VCIA — Vice City International Airport. HOW: In free-roam at the airport, take a plane you were never scheduled to fly and get airborne in it; the story mission VCIA Takedown teaches the airport's layout, and the free-roam version simply asks you to steal the departure rather than be given it. Expect a wanted level, so line the aircraft up and commit to the takeoff roll. WHEN: Not missable; the airport stays open in free-roam. Sources beside this guide carry the official description and the VCIA mission context.
steps: Head to VCIA in free-roam and reach the airfield side.
Take an aircraft you are not scheduled to fly.
Get airborne to make the departure.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: WHAT: The official description is a joke — 'Kinda hot in these Rhinos' — and a Rhino is the series' name for a tank, so this hidden trophy is about getting into or surviving a Rhino tank. HOW: The cited roundups list this among the hidden free-roam trophies whose exact trigger the launch guides had not yet pinned down; the safe play is to steal a Rhino when military heat brings one out, and spend time driving and fighting in it. WHEN: Not missable; tanks appear at high wanted levels in free-roam. Because the trigger is unconfirmed in the sources, this guide claims no more than they do — check the cited lists for updates. Sources beside this guide carry the official description.
steps: Raise your wanted level until military vehicles respond.
Steal a Rhino tank when one arrives.
Drive and fight in the Rhino until the trophy pops.

sources.name: Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: WHAT: Rob a jewelry store and get away without ever being detected. HOW: This is a stealth robbery, the opposite of the loud bank jobs: case the store, enter quietly, keep staff and customers calm, take the goods and leave before any alarm state counts as detection. If you are spotted, walk away and retry another day rather than forcing it — a detected attempt cannot be salvaged for this trophy. WHEN: Not missable; jewelry stores can be robbed again in free-roam. Sources beside this guide carry the official description.
steps: Choose a jewelry store and watch its routine first.
Enter quietly and control the room without raising detection.
Take the goods and leave undetected.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: WHAT: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape each time. HOW: Bank vault robberies are a headline free-roam crime: plan an exit vehicle before you go in, clear the vault fast, and lose the heat on the way out — the escape is part of the requirement, so a bust at the door does not count. The cited roadmap lists robberies among the must-complete lines of the 100% checklist, so these five are on the platinum path regardless. WHEN: Not missable; banks stay robbable in free-roam, and robbery trophies open up around Chapters 3-4. Sources beside this guide confirm the count and checklist status.
steps: Park a fast getaway car before entering the bank.
Clear the vault quickly and leave on your planned route.
Lose the wanted level fully; repeat at 5 different vaults.

sources.name: Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: WHAT: Rob one armored truck and escape. HOW: Armored trucks run routes in free-roam; stop or breach the truck, grab the cash, and lose the responding heat — as with the bank vaults, the escape is written into the description, so the job is not done until your wanted level is gone. A heavy vehicle of your own makes stopping the truck far easier than shooting at it from a car. WHEN: Not missable; trucks keep spawning in free-roam. Sources beside this guide carry the official description.
steps: Find an armored truck on its route and block it with a heavy vehicle.
Breach it and take the cash.
Escape until the wanted level fully clears.

Leave the tracker counter (x / 52) open as your checklist and save isolated islands and the far corners for one dedicated boat-and-plane sweep at the end. steps: Sweep the mainland region by region, visiting every named area.
Combine the sweep with spots, cards and WAiNK locations.
Finish with one boat/plane trip for islands and corners; counter reads 52 / 52.

Sources beside this guide carry the official description and the 9-gang count.
steps: Identify each gang's turf and one operation inside it.
Rob one operation, then move to a different gang's territory.
Repeat until all 9 gangs have been robbed once.

WHEN: Not missable; Ocean Beach is open all game. Sources beside this guide carry the official description.
steps: Go to Ocean Beach in free-roam.
Find a bar spot with a view over the water.
Order a cocktail and stay for the scene.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.missable_note: SAVE-SENSITIVE — this trophy tracks choices made (PSN counts to 500). Choices cannot be revisited: there is no mission replay, so keep a manual save before major story decisions and never rely on one autosave slot.
trophies.guide: WHAT: Make choices — for better or worse — with PlayStation tracking a count that runs to 500. HOW: Choices are the decisions the game puts in front of Jason and Lucia, in missions and in the world; the counter rewards a long, engaged playthrough rather than any single decision, so play naturally, take optional conversations and decisions when offered, and do not rush past them. WHEN: Treat individual choices as one-time: with no mission replay, a choice you regret is gone, which is why the roadmap's rotating manual saves matter — save before big story decisions so a branch is never lost by accident. The trophy itself builds across the whole run toward the 500 count. Sources beside this guide carry the official description and the tracked count.
steps: Keep a manual save before major story decisions.
Take optional choices and conversations instead of skipping them.
Let the counter build across the playthrough toward 500.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: WHAT: 'Second time's the charm' — succeed at something on your second attempt after failing it once. HOW: The cited launch guides list this among the hidden trophies whose exact trigger was still unconfirmed, so the working method is structural: when the game gives you a scored or pass/fail attempt, a genuine fail followed by a success on the retry is the shape this description describes. Keep a manual save before one-time attempts so a first-try success does not lock you out of engineering the fail-then-succeed sequence elsewhere. WHEN: Treat it as save-sensitive for the same no-replay reason; there are many repeatable attempts in free-roam, so do not panic if the story passes without it. Sources beside this guide carry the official description.
steps: Save manually before one-time pass/fail attempts.
If you fail an attempt, retry it immediately and succeed.
If you succeeded first try, use a repeatable free-roam attempt instead.
